search_query.title: Search query
search_query.description: Query for Bluesky's searchPosts (supports OR, quotes, hashtags). Required when mode='search'.

sort.title: Sort order (search mode)
sort.description: How to rank results when mode='search'. 'latest' returns newest first; 'top' returns highest-engagement first.

language.title: Language filter (BCP-47)
language.description: Limit search to posts in this language (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'ja'). Leave empty for all languages.

since.title: Posts since (ISO datetime, search mode)
since.description: Only include posts after this datetime, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z

until.title: Posts until (ISO datetime, search mode)
until.description: Only include posts before this datetime.

actors.title: Bluesky handles or DIDs
actors.description: Required when mode='author_feed'. One handle per row (without @).

author_filter.title: Author-feed filter
author_filter.description: Which posts to include when scraping an author's feed (mode='author_feed').

max_items.title: Max posts total
max_items.description: Hard cap across all queries/actors. Default 100. Set higher for bigger runs.

max_items_per_actor.title: Max posts per actor (author_feed mode)
max_items_per_actor.description: Per-actor cap when scraping multiple Bluesky handles. Total run is still bounded by max_items.

enrich_with_claude.title: Enrich with Claude (sentiment / topics / entities / summary)
enrich_with_claude.description: Adds a `semantic` field to each output post. Requires an Anthropic Claude API key.

claude_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (required if enrichment ON)
claude_api_key.description: Starts with sk-ant-... Get one at console.anthropic.com.

claude_model.title: Claude model
claude_model.description: Anthropic model to use for enrichment. Haiku is cheapest; Opus is most accurate.

enrichment_fields.title: Which enrichment fields to compute
enrichment_fields.description: Cost scales with fields enabled. Sentiment + topics is cheapest.
